hypothesis: The exposure-filtered full-N14 hybrid is noninferior to the supplied N15 target-graph oracle within0.1percentage points in certificate-first N20 accuracy, with zero wrong stopped chains.
antecedent: Source-global absences transferred as false exclusions in H3o/H3p. Test a fixed source-only independence-model exposure heuristic without a radius cutoff or target-based threshold tuning.

exposure.expected_count: For each offset o, E_o=N*sum_over_valid_source_placements(i,j with displacement o)(p_i*p_j), where p_i=source_occupied_count_i/N and N=5180. Equivalently sum(m_i*m_j)/N.
exposure.finite_rule: Retain an observed-zero finite offset iff E_o>=natural_log(K/0.01). No additional condition. All originally inferred homogeneous lines remain unchanged.
exposure.interpretation: Independent-cell-occupancy exposure heuristic only. The constrained source solutions do not satisfy that independence model. No calibrated p-values, multiple-testing guarantee, confidence coverage or Bonferroni validity is claimed.

line_family: Enumerate integer(a,b) in[-2,2]^2 except(0,0), gcd(abs(a),abs(b))=1, canonical sign(first nonzero positive). A line is a*dr+b*dc=0. Retain iff it contains>=3 zero-count offsets in that arms source domain and0 positive-count offsets. Retain all qualifying lines; no target selection.
construction: Compute source marginals, literal offset co-occurrences and independent-occupancy expected counts from all5180 N14 patterns only. The control retains all zero offsets; the new arm filters finite zero offsets by the declared exposure threshold. Both union their finite constraints with the unchanged inferred homogeneous lines. Target J=15*forbidden-1, diagonal/unary0. Oracle explicitly supplies target attacks.

calibration.explanation: Target q15 is supplied. Symbolic delta=q-1,tau=-q(q-1)/2; inherited N12 unit unchanged from H3n. No target-label calibration.

search.stop: strict local margin plus q-cardinality gate

decision: Support if exact one-sided95% upper probability of any paired-seed accuracy regression within an input<=0.001 and zero filtered-arm wrong stopped chains. Falsify if paired-input bootstrap one-sided95% upper filtered-minus-oracle accuracy difference<-0.1pp OR any filtered wrong stop; otherwise inconclusive.2000bootstrap draws,RNG20261114,all3searchseeds clustered within input. Filtered-versus-unfiltered comparison and coverage descriptive.
diagnostics: After construction audit retained/removed offsets, score distribution, target graph errors, all saved outputs and valid-certificate capacity. No score inspection precedes protocol freezing; no target diagnostic changes coefficients or thresholds.
identity: Deduplicate only exact S,B,q,delta,tau,unit equality, before target search, keeping all four logical arms and explicit matched-seed mappings. First arm in frozen order is representative.

dataset.transfer: N14 to N15 upward transfer with a source-only independence-model exposure heuristic.
dataset.target_distribution: Uniform unique valid1/2/3clue N15 superqueen inputs excluding all H3o/H3p search inputs. The full target universe was already enumerated and structurally censused in H3q; fresh here means no prior search-cohort overlap, not unseen target labels.
dataset.new_method: Source-only marginal exposure threshold fixed before scores are computed. Inferred homogeneous lines, target q, unit and search settings stay inherited.

limits: The exposure threshold is a heuristic under an independence model, not a calibrated test or Bonferroni guarantee for constrained solutions.
